adversarialFindings.description: Wrong native-unit aggregation, borrowed date counts, same-identity pairs, empty plans or an arbitrary final entry could award an approved badge on the wrong history or record the wrong witness.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Source tracing and independent full-prefix reference comparison found the implementation keeps native totals and date sets separate, uses different stable IDs for Merge Quest, counts nonempty enabled historical goals, and emits the earliest qualifying current-valid date/ID prefix. All twelve authored rule paths and exact witness IDs agreed in the varied-history probe and focused tests.

adversarialFindings.description: Activity persistence and unlock creation could partially commit, duplicate on replay, revoke earned state after edits/deletion or announce rewards on restore/passive reads.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The entry-save coordinated Dexie transaction includes the four Activity stores and achievementUnlocks, and reuses the unique/idempotent unlock routine. Independently passing persistence tests force unlock failure and verify rollback of the entry/day, actual save-time award timestamps, edit/delete retention, exact backup round-trip, silent restore, later explicit-save recognition and reset. Reward announcement follows only the committed mutation result; source paths for settings/delete/read/restore never invoke the evaluator.

adversarialFindings.description: The extension could alter approved copy/art, duplicate shared identities across programmes, admit physical rules into educational evaluation or change existing educational progression and preserved catalogue order.
adversarialFindings.resolution: External input byte checks and focused fidelity/dispatch tests confirm all twelve exact approved runtime records and assets, shared catalogue membership and zero XP. Educational evaluation explicitly ignores physical_activity. Changed historical tests preserve the prior educational oracle while separately pinning the extension. The write path does not write education/XP stores, and snapshot comparison verifies unrelated state preservation.
